lines.welcome2: I live on this Mac, not in the cloud.
lines.welcome3: I ask before I do anything that matters.
lines.welcome4: And if this Mac is closed or off, I'm off too.
lines.pickAI: Which AI do you already pay for? I'll use it as my brain. You can switch any time.
lines.signin: I'm opening the sign-in page in your browser. Sign in there, then come back here.
lines.signinFailed: That sign-in didn't finish. Want to try again, or pick another one?
lines.checking: You're connected. Let me check I can think with it.
lines.nameAssistant: It works. Now, what would you like to call me? You can rename me any time.
lines.nameUser: I like it. And what should I call you?
lines.connect: Want me to connect anything? Pick as many as you like, or tell me in your own words.
lines.whichEmail: Which email do you use? Pick all that apply. You can add as many accounts as you like.
lines.passwords: When I need to log in somewhere, where should I find your passwords?
lines.passwordsOK: I need your OK for that first. I'll only look up a login when a task needs it, and I'll tell you which one.
lines.askEach: Okay. I'll ask you each time, and I won't keep anything.
lines.notNow: No problem. I'll ask again when it's needed.
lines.allSet: You're all set. Here are a few things I can do right now. Tap one, or just ask.
lines.memory: I also have a memory, and it's yours. It lives on this Mac as plain files, so even if you switch AIs, I still remember.
lines.personalRoom: Everything starts in your personal room: family, home, health, plans.
lines.roomsQuestion: Want to keep part of your life separate, like a job or a business? I'll give it its own room, where I act differently and keep its notes apart.
lines.roomsSimple: Your personal room is ready. If you ever want another one, just ask.
lines.roomsDone: Done. Each room keeps its own notes, and I act the way you want in each one.
lines.backupQuestion: One last thing. Want me to back up your memory to iCloud, so it's safe if something happens to this Mac?
lines.backupOn: Backup is on. I'll keep a copy in your iCloud Drive.
lines.backupOff: Okay. Your memory stays only on this Mac. Ask me any time to turn backup on.
lines.worldIntro: This is everything I can reach from your Mac.
lines.tourFiles: I find, sort and tidy the folders you allow.
lines.tourBrowser: I open sites and click through them as you, in your own browser.
lines.tourEmail: I read every inbox you have, and tell you what matters.
lines.tourCalendar: I keep your days straight, and warn you before things clash.
lines.tourPhone: Text me from your phone, while this Mac does the work.
lines.tourPasswords: I sign in for you with your password manager, only with your OK.
lines.worldPick: What would you like me to look after?
lines.tourWeb: I look things up for you, and come back with a short, clear answer.
lines.tourNews: I follow the stories you care about, and tell you each morning.
lines.installing: First, I'm setting myself up on this Mac. This only happens once. Please hang on while I get ready.
lines.devTools: Your Mac needs one small Apple add-on first. Click Install on the box that just opened, then press Continue here when it's done.
lines.installFailed: Something stopped the setup. Check your internet connection, and try again.
